validation_rules.statement: No applicable HVPQ question should be blank.
validation_rules.machine_logic: Flag blank/NA unless parent response is No/not applicable or section is explicitly exempt.
validation_rules.evidence_required: Question text, parent answer, extracted answer.
validation_rules.action_if_fail: Update missing HVPQ response or mark as N/A with valid parent logic.
skip_when: chemical-only sections for pure oil ship

validation_rules.statement: No certificate should be expired.
validation_rules.machine_logic: For each certificate expiry date, fail if expiry < reference date.
validation_rules.evidence_required: Certificate name, issue date, annual/intermediate endorsement, expiry.
validation_rules.action_if_fail: Renew certificate or correct HVPQ/Class entry.

validation_rules.statement: Certificates issued more than 1 year ago require annual endorsement within 12 months and alignment with 1.5.11.
validation_rules.machine_logic: If issue_date + 12 months < reference_date, latest annual endorsement must be within 12 months and match HVPQ 1.5.11 where applicable.
validation_rules.evidence_required: Issue date, latest annual endorsement, HVPQ 1.5.11.
validation_rules.action_if_fail: Correct endorsement date or update HVPQ annual survey response.

validation_rules.statement: Certificates issued more than 2.5 years ago require intermediate endorsement within 30 months and alignment with 1.5.12.
validation_rules.machine_logic: If issue_date + 30 months < reference_date, latest intermediate endorsement must be within 30 months and match HVPQ 1.5.12 where applicable.
validation_rules.action_if_fail: Correct endorsement date or update HVPQ intermediate survey response.

validation_rules.statement: P&I wreck removal cover must be Yes.
validation_rules.machine_logic: Normalize response; pass only if Yes.
validation_rules.action_if_fail: Correct declaration or obtain P&I evidence.

validation_rules.statement: If vessel age is above 15 years, CAP rating is applicable and should be 1.
validation_rules.machine_logic: Compute age from delivery/build date; if >15 years, CAP response must exist and rating must equal 1.
validation_rules.evidence_required: Delivery/build date, CAP applicability, CAP rating.
validation_rules.action_if_fail: Update CAP declaration/rating or provide justification.

validation_rules.statement: Class society IACS member response must be Yes.
validation_rules.machine_logic: Normalize response; pass only if Yes.
validation_rules.action_if_fail: Correct IACS response or class details.

validation_rules.statement: Last dry dock should not be older than 5 years and must match last special/dry dock response where applicable.
validation_rules.machine_logic: Fail if last dry dock date + 5 years < reference date; compare HVPQ 1.5.4.1 with 1.5.6.1/Class status date.
validation_rules.evidence_required: Last dry dock date, special survey date, Class status.
validation_rules.action_if_fail: Correct HVPQ/Class data or verify survey evidence.

validation_rules.statement: If 1.9.1 is No, 1.9.2 cannot also be No/blank where follow-up details are required.
validation_rules.machine_logic: Check parent/child incident logic; blank/no contradiction must be flagged for manual review.

validation_rules.statement: Response for 3.2.1 should be No.
validation_rules.machine_logic: Normalize response; pass only if No.

validation_rules.statement: HVPQ 3.3.4 courses should include ERM simulator, cargo simulator, and ship handling type courses and align with PIQ training entries.
validation_rules.machine_logic: Extract course text; require concepts engine-room resource management/simulator, cargo simulator, ship handling; compare with PIQ courses.
validation_rules.evidence_required: Course names in HVPQ and PIQ.
validation_rules.action_if_fail: Update course list or clarify equivalence.

validation_rules.statement: 5.3.1.4 date should not be older than 12 months.
validation_rules.machine_logic: Fail if date + 12 months < reference date.

validation_rules.statement: Cargo/slop tank coating inspection dates by ship staff must be within stated frequency and align with PIQ 2.3.3001.
validation_rules.machine_logic: Read table last inspection date column, not original coating date. Oldest last inspection + frequency months must be >= reference date. Compare PIQ oldest/frequency.
validation_rules.evidence_required: Frequency, all last inspection dates, oldest inspection date.

validation_rules.statement: Ballast tank coating inspections by competent person must be within stated frequency and align with PIQ 2.3.3002.
validation_rules.machine_logic: Read table last inspection date column, not coating application date. Oldest last inspection + frequency months must be >= reference date.
validation_rules.evidence_required: Frequency, all last inspection dates, oldest inspection date.

validation_rules.statement: 7.1.4.5 response should be greater than zero and expressed in percent.
validation_rules.machine_logic: Parse numeric value and unit; fail if value <=0 or no % unit/percentage context.

validation_rules.statement: If cargo tank capacity/parameter in 1.6.1 is greater than 200, pump type should be Centrifugal; otherwise Deepwell.
validation_rules.machine_logic: Parse 1.6.1 numeric and pump type. If >200 require Centrifugal; else require Deepwell. Cross-check Q88 pump type.
validation_rules.action_if_fail: Correct pump type or verify mapping.

validation_rules.statement: Date of last brake holding capacity test must be within brake test frequency.
validation_rules.machine_logic: Extract brake test date and frequency; fail if last test + frequency < reference date.
validation_rules.evidence_required: HVPQ/Q88 brake test date and frequency.
validation_rules.action_if_fail: Update brake test date or conduct test.

validation_rules.statement: Wire, tails and ropes must be within allowed age: wire 10 years, tails 18 months, ropes 5 years.
validation_rules.machine_logic: For each mooring line row, parse type and installed date; fail if age exceeds type limit.
validation_rules.evidence_required: Line type and installed date for each wire/tail/rope.
validation_rules.action_if_fail: Replace overdue line or correct date/type.

validation_rules.statement: Last annual and five-year lifting appliance tests must not be expired.
validation_rules.machine_logic: Annual test <=12 months; five-year test <=60 months from reference date.
validation_rules.action_if_fail: Update test details or arrange test.

validation_rules.statement: PIQ vessel type must match HVPQ vessel type.
validation_rules.machine_logic: Normalize vessel type categories and compare.
validation_rules.action_if_fail: Correct one document or justify terminology difference.

validation_rules.statement: Static and dynamic navigational assessments cannot both be Yes or both be No; responses must be opposite.
validation_rules.machine_logic: Normalize both answers; fail if equal or blank.

validation_rules.statement: Last navigational assessment date must not be older than 12 months.
validation_rules.machine_logic: Use whichever assessment is marked Yes; latest date + 12 months must be >= reference date.

validation_rules.statement: If Chapter 3.5, 3.6 or 3.7 is marked Yes, last audit date must not be older than 12 months.
validation_rules.machine_logic: For each Yes audit, parse date; fail if date +12 months < reference date.

validation_rules.statement: PIQ 3.4.2001 date must be within 12 months and 3.4.2002 within 3 months.
validation_rules.machine_logic: Fail if 3.4.2001 +12 months or 3.4.2002 +3 months is before reference date.

validation_rules.statement: PIQ 5.2.4 must match HVPQ 5.3.2 sub question 4.
validation_rules.machine_logic: Normalize and compare answers.

validation_rules.statement: PIQ incident declarations must align with HVPQ incident responses, and damage/other/occasional Class visit purpose may imply damage/repair verification.
validation_rules.machine_logic: Compare PIQ incident yes/no matrix with HVPQ 1.9.1-1.9.7. If Class visit purpose includes damage/other/occasional, require incident/repair explanation.
validation_rules.evidence_required: PIQ incident matrix, HVPQ incidents, Class/PIQ survey purpose.

validation_rules.statement: PIQ PSC information must align with HVPQ PSC responses.
validation_rules.machine_logic: Compare last PSC date/port/detention/deficiency data.

validation_rules.statement: PIQ Section 8.3 responses must align with HVPQ vapor emission control and venting sections.
validation_rules.machine_logic: Map VEC/venting fitted/operational/arrangement answers and compare.

validation_rules.statement: PIQ 10.2.1 must match HVPQ 11.3.3.
validation_rules.machine_logic: Normalize and compare answer/value.

validation_rules.statement: PIQ 10.2.3 must match HVPQ 11.9.1.
validation_rules.machine_logic: Normalize and compare answer/value.

validation_rules.statement: Technical Superintendent visit must be within 7 months and successive visit gaps must not exceed 7.0 months.
validation_rules.machine_logic: Sort visit date ranges; latest visit end/date must be <=7.0 months old and every successive gap <=7.0 months. Strict no tolerance.

validation_rules.statement: Marine Superintendent visit must be within 12 months and successive visit gaps must not exceed 12.0 months.
validation_rules.machine_logic: Sort visit date ranges; latest visit end/date must be <=12.0 months old and every successive gap <=12.0 months. Strict no tolerance.

validation_rules.statement: PIQ cargo/slop tank inspection frequency and oldest date must align with HVPQ 7.1.1.
validation_rules.machine_logic: Compare PIQ required frequency and oldest inspection date against HVPQ tank coating last inspection dates and frequency.

validation_rules.statement: PIQ ballast tank inspection frequency and oldest date must align with HVPQ 7.1.3.
validation_rules.machine_logic: Compare PIQ required frequency and oldest inspection date against HVPQ tank coating last inspection dates and frequency.
validation_rules.action_if_fail: Correct stale/mismatched ballast tank inspection data.
